resources.cpu_budget_basis: Prepared12 host slots each use1 CPU on observed16-CPU host, leaving4 for vLLM and orchestration. This is accounting headroom, not a claim of pinned or independently reserved cores; actual run wall time remains measured.

resource_probe_command: import os,json; s=os.statvfs("/host-docker"); m=open("/proc/meminfo").read().splitlines(); print(json.dumps({"docker_free_bytes":s.f_bavail*s.f_frsize,"host_mem_available_bytes":int(next(x.split()[1] for x in m if x.startswith("MemAvailable:")))*1024,"host_cpu_count":os.cpu_count()}))

correction.reason: Initial checker accidentally required16 additional host CPUs beyond12 sandbox CPUs; that28-core condition was not in the prepared12-slot contract. Corrected to4-core headroom without altering task resources, worker count or observed hardware.
